In this eye-opening episode we uncover the dark, pagan roots of "Christmas" and reveal how ancient customs have been repackaged and celebrated for centuries. It goes much deeper than just Yule. Discover how these practices trace back to rituals steeped in paganism and mythology that date back to Biblical times. Learn why it’s vital to discern the truth about this festive season. From the worship of evergreen trees to the mysterious origins of Santa Claus, we’ll explore what’s really behind the holiday cheer.
